def: to interweave (colored) threads in squares; by implication (of reticulation) to inchase gems in gold

occurrences.text: And the fourth row a beryl, and an onyx, and a jasper: they shall be set in gold in their inclosings.
And thou shalt embroider the coat of fine linen, and thou shalt make the mitre of fine linen, and thou shalt make the girdle of needlework.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
